jobs.title: LEHRKRAFT (M/W/D) FÜR ELEMENTARE MUSIKPÄDAGOGIK (EMP)
jobs.description:
Die Musikschule Konstanz, 1984 gegründet, ist ein Betriebsteil des kommunalen Eigenbetriebs OMK (Orchesterkultur und Musikbildung Konstanz).
86 engagierte Lehrkräfte unterrichten in nahezu 1.900 Belegungen fast alle musikalischen Facetten. Die Musikschule fördert nicht nur talentierte SchülerInnen in einer speziellen Begabtenklasse, sondern kooperiert auch mit allgemeinbildenden Schulen, Musikvereinen und kirchlichen Einrichtungen. Zudem engagiert sich die Musikschule in der frühkindlichen Bildung durch Kooperationen mit Kitas, einschließlich des Landesförderprogramms SBS (Singen - Bewegen - Sprechen). Projekte wie „Kultur macht stark“ sowie Seniorenarbeit und die Unterstützung von Menschen mit Beeinträchtigungen sind ebenfalls Teil des vielfältigen Angebots. Die Musikschule ist an 28 Orten in Konstanz präsent und hat ihren Hauptsitz in einem zentral gelegenen denkmalgeschützten ehemaligen Kloster. Die Musikschule Konstanz trägt somit aktiv zur kulturellen Bildung und Integration in der Region bei.
Klingt interessant für Sie? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.
DIE MUSIKSCHULE KONSTANZ SUCHT ZUM 01.03.2027:
**LEHRKRAFT (M/W/D) FÜR ELEMENTARE MUSIKPÄDAGOGIK (EMP)**
### Mit den Aufgabenschwerpunkten:
- Unterricht in allen Formaten der elementaren Musikpädagogik im Vorschulalter und darüber hinaus (Eltern-Kind-Gruppen, musikalische Früherziehung etc.)
- Je nach Qualifikation Unterricht in einem instrumentalen Zweitfach. Ergänzend kann auch Unterricht im Förderprogramm "Kolibri" des Landes im Fach "Singen-Bewegen-Sprechen" hinzukommen
- Mitarbeit bei der Entwicklung neuer Angebote und Vorbereitung von Veranstaltungen und Aufführungen
### DAS BIETEN WIR:
- Eine unbefristete Teilzeitstelle (19,5 Std./Woche) mit allen Leistungen des öffentlichen Dienstes
- Eine Vergütung nach EG 9b TVöD (1.889 € – 2.656 €)
- Die Mitarbeit in einer modernen, erfolgreichen Bildungseinrichtung mit rund 1.900 SchülerInnen
- Eine kollegiale Arbeitsatmosphäre mit einem künstlerisch und pädagogisch hoch qualifizierten Kollegium mit vielen Möglichkeiten, sich künstlerisch und pädagogisch zu entfalten
- Ein attraktives Arbeitsumfeld in einem eigenen, sehr gut ausgestatteten historischen Gebäude in zentraler Lage von Konstanz
- Jahressonderzahlung und Leistungsentgelt
- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
- **Mobilitätszuschuss:**
Jobticket-Zuschuss zum ÖPNV
- **Betriebliche Gesundheitsförderung:**
Ihre Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen. Daher bieten wir verschiedene Gesundheitsförderungsprogramme an – inklusive Firmenfitness mit Epassi (ehemals Hansefit)
- Fachliche Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
### DAS BRINGEN SIE MIT:
- Ein abgeschlossenes musikpädagogisches Hochschulstudium im Fach "Elementare Musikpädagogik" oder einen vergleichbaren Abschluss
- Eventuell ein instrumentales Zweitfach und/oder ein SBS-Zertifikat
- Motivation,  Engagement und Teamfähigkeit
- Interesse an Kooperationsprojekten
- Offenheit für neue Unterrichtskonzepte und -ideen
**KONTAKT:**
Bei Fragen zum Aufgabengebiet:

jobs.title: Manufacturing Trainings Specialist - Vulcanizing
jobs.description: Location: Haag, St. Gallen, CH Employment Type: Permanent About VAT Group At VAT, we change the world with vacuum solutions. As the world’s leading supplier of high-performance vacuum valves, we have been driving innovation for more than 60 years. With over 3,200 employees worldwide, we operate from our headquarters in Haag, Switzerland, with manufacturing sites in Switzerland, Malaysia and Romania, as well as sales and service hubs around the world. We are guided by our passions: integrity, teamwork, customer centricity, and innovation – always working together as #oneVAT. Joining us means becoming part of a passionate, international team where your voice is heard, your ideas matter, and your career growth is supported. Purpose of the Role In this role, you will be responsible for the qualification, training, and development of employees within the Vulcanizing area. By delivering effective training programs and ensuring compliance with qualification standards, you will play a key role in supporting product quality, process reliability, and the successful onboarding of employees in a dynamic manufacturing environment. Responsibilities Plan, coordinate, and deliver foundational and job-specific training programs within the Vulcanizing area. Ensure structured and role-based qualification of new and existing employees. Organize, conduct, and document initial certifications and re-certifications. Monitor training progress and ensure compliance with defined qualification requirements. Analyze knowledge assessments and identify required refresher and development training activities. Develop, maintain, and continuously improve training materials and training concepts in collaboration with operational departments and Quality Assurance. Support the continuous improvement of training, qualification, and onboarding processes. Provide technical guidance and coaching to employees throughout their onboarding and qualification journey. Participate in cross-functional and global training and qualification initiatives. Qualifications Completed vocational training and/or further education in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Manufacturing, or a comparable technical discipline. Very good written and spoken German and English skills. Several years of experience in an industrial manufacturing environment. Strong knowledge of production and manufacturing processes. Experience in employee training, onboarding, coaching, or qualification programs is advantageous. Strong quality mindset with a structured and self-directed approach to work. Ability to communicate technical knowledge clearly and effectively to different audiences. High level of interpersonal skills, empathy, and enthusiasm for working with people from diverse backgrounds and experience levels. Motivating personality with strong coaching skills and a role-model mindset. Excellent communication and teamwork skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications. Our commitment to inclusion, fairness and equal opportunities We believe in meaningful careers, continuous learning, and equal opportunities for everyone to drive our innovation and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace. If you have concerns, our compliance channel is available at our website. All reports are handled with strict confidentiality and in accordance with our Code of Conduct. jobs.title: Senior Fachspezialist Finanz- und Rechnungswesen (w/m/d) Teilzeit/Vollzeit
Greffier/-ère de Cour I, Do 1-6, langue principale allemande
FP&A Manager
jobs.description: FP&A Manager | 80–100% | St. Gallen, Switzerland We are hiring an FP&A Manager to build the finance engine behind our next growth stage. This is a build role. You will own planning, forecasting and performance insight, and you will redesign how it works: automated, AI-assisted and decision-ready, instead of spreadsheet-driven and manual. You report to the CFO and work with the leadership team and board. What you will do Own planning and forecasting: run budget, rolling forecast and scenario planning across our data and drone businesses; make forecasts faster, more frequent and more accurate. Build an AI-first FP&A stack: design automated data pipelines and agentic workflows (variance commentary, forecast refreshes, board pack drafts, anomaly detection) on top of NetSuite, HubSpot and our main tools Turn data into decisions: deliver clear insight on ARR, retention, unit economics, margins and cash, with a point of view and a recommendation, not just numbers. Partner with the business: be the finance counterpart to Sales, RevOps, Product and Operations; challenge assumptions and support pricing, headcount and investment decisions. Own management and board reporting: monthly, quarterly and annual reporting that is accurate, on time and increasingly self-serve. Build business cases and models: investments, pricing, new markets and strategic initiatives, with clear scenarios and risks. Support fundraising and lenders: maintain the financial model and KPI data that underpin investor and bank conversations. Raise the bar: set standards for data quality, documentation and controls, and coach colleagues to use AI tools in everyday finance work. What you bring Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting or a related field. 3-5 years in FP&A, controlling, or finance consulting, ideally in a scale-up or tech environment. Strong modelling skills and hands-on experience with planning tools and ERP/CRM data (NetSuite, HubSpot). Demonstrated AI-first habits: you already use LLMs and automation in your work, and can show examples (e.g agent workflows). Solid grasp of recurring revenue (SaaS) business model and metrics such as ARR, NRR and churn. Sharp analytical thinking and the ability to turn complex data into a clear recommendation. Excellent English; German is a plus. Drive, curiosity and ownership: you like building, challenge the status quo and thrive in a fast-moving environment. Strong business partnering and stakeholder management skills, with experience building collaborative relationships across functions and constructively challenging senior stakeholders What we offer Build and shape the future of finance: Take ownership of key finance processes and have the freedom to introduce new tools, automation and AI-driven ways of working. Make a real business impact: Work directly with our CFO and leadership team, providing insights that influence strategic and commercial decisions. Broad exposure and responsibility: Gain visibility across the business, from commercial performance and operations to strategic investments and growth initiatives. An international, collaborative environment: Join a motivated team with flat hierarchies, short decision-making processes and the opportunity to make things happen. At Meteomatics, we're passionate about transforming how weather and climate data is used around the world. Our technology helps organisations make better decisions, achieve their business goals and protect lives and property. As we continue to grow, you'll have the opportunity to help shape how we manage our financial performance and make decisions, contributing directly to the next stage of Meteomatics' development. Still reading? We are looking forward to your application!
